plugins.name: harness-kit
plugins.description: A cloneable, de-anonymized personal harness for working with AI agents: a hot canon of hard rules, self-learning, knowledge + activities that survive sessions, an agent-owned structure, and a concierge stance. /harness-init sets up a freshly-cloned base; /harness-add-skill runs the skill-creation gate; /harness-doctor health-checks it. Solo, cross-agent (Claude / Codex / Cursor), domain-agnostic.
